name: Soltaniyeh
description: In Iran's Zanjan province, Soltaniyeh was once the capital of the Mongol Ilkhanid dynasty. Its centrepiece is the mausoleum of Oljaytu, built between 1302 and 1312. An octagonal building, it is topped by a turquoise-tiled dome about 50 metres high and ringed by eight slender minarets. It is Iran's oldest surviving double-shelled dome, and one scholar saw it as a forerunner of the Taj Mahal.
